text:
maria-eng-sre: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for last night's LB/DNS incident (postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/2024-03-20-lb-dns-outage). We need clear owners, timelines, and a tracker for recurring patterns (routing bug + TLS handshake retries causing LB overload).

devin-platform: I've started a ticket TICKET-1278 for the DNS TTL misconfig (we had 24h drift on a few zones). I'll take ownership of reducing TTL and adding alerting. Proposed changes: TTL -> 60s for internal load-balancer records and add heartbeat check.

kai-network: I'll own routing bug fix (INC-421). Root cause looks like a race in the cross-region route-sync where stale route table entries cause TLS handshake to fail-to-connect, which then triggers client retries. I'll put up a branch with e2e test by EOD Thu, and plan a staged rollout Fri.

maria-eng-sre: Thanks. Can you also add a small canary that forces cross-region traffic through the fixed path so we can validate without full cutover?

kai-network: Yep. Canary plan will be in the INC-421 PR.

sanjay-ops: For mitigation, we should add a short-term circuit-breaker on the LB to stop retry storms from saturating backends. I'll own that work (OPS-332). Plan: feature toggle + default limits by Tue next week. Also will add token-bucket-based ingress throttling at the edge.

lisa-product: I'll own customer comms and will prepare a short blurb for affected customers. If we have an ETA on the DNS TTL change and LB circuit-breaker I'll send an update tonight.

devin-platform: Quick config snippet I'm planning to deploy (internal DNS):
```
zone "svc.internal" {
  ttl 60;
  notify yes;
}
```
I'll also add a Grafana panel for DNS-NAME->resolve-latency and an alert if resolution fails > 5% over 5m.

maria-eng-sre: Action items summary (putting them here so it's tracked):
- A1 (owner: kai-network) INC-421: fix route-sync race + canary (ETA: PR by Thu, canary Fri)
- A2 (owner: devin-platform) TICKET-1278: DNS TTL -> 60s + monitoring (ETA: deploy tonight)
- A3 (owner: sanjay-ops) OPS-332: LB circuit-breaker + ingress throttling (ETA: Tue next week)
- A4 (owner: lisa-product) Customer comms and status page update (ETA: tonight)
- A5 (owner: maria-eng-sre) Follow-up retro next Wed to check recurrence metrics and ensure rollout success

kai-network: Noted. Also proposing a small post-deploy test to validate TLS handshakes across region pairs: script will simulate handshake + 3x retry at increasing intervals. I'll add to the PR.

devin-platform: After TTL change, will run a 24h drift audit across all zones and create an automated job to detect TTL anomalies (monthly).

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: Follow-up retro meeting created for 2024-03-27 15:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent to participants.

maria-eng-sre: Let's also track incident recurrence pattern: this is the 3rd cross-region routing-related incident in 6 months (see PM notes). We need a metrics dashboard that shows cross-region failure rate + retry amplification factor. I'll create a ticket to formalize that (REC-76).

sanjay-ops: For the LB throttles, I'll add an emergency runbook step to flip the feature toggle to ON for startups/traffic surges. We'll add a dev-sre oncall checklist item.

lisa-product: If we hit any blocking issues during canary, I'll pause customer comms and send a quick note to the incident channel.

maria-eng-sre: Great. I'll update the postmortem with the above action items and link the tickets. Can owners drop a short ACK with estimate in INC-421/TICKET-1278/OPS-332 by EOD?

kai-network: ACK, estimate added.

devin-platform: ACK, deploy scheduled 2024-03-21 22:30 UTC.

sanjay-ops: ACK, initial rollout Tue 2024-03-26.

lisa-product: ACK, comms draft ready.

maria-eng-sre: Closing loop—please ping here if timelines slip. We'll track in the incident board and ensure the retro covers recurring pattern remediation (REC-76). :thumbsup:
